companyDescription: Quantum computing · trapped-ion systems + networking/quantum-security rollup (Elisity pending) · FY26 revenue guide $280-290M, organic growth 132% · freshly recapitalized with a $2B equity raise
priceNote: Live $34.99 on Nov 11, 2026. The prior report (Oct 26) used $30.15, a +16.1% drift. The Nov 5 Q3 catalyst has resolved.
summary: RESOLVED (Q3, Nov 5) — a beat-and-raise. Revenue was $173.8M (+336% y/y, including $83.5M from SkyWater; the core platform was $90.3M, +127%) vs ~$141M est. The FY26 guide was raised to $505–515M from $450–460M, and RPO is $1.2B. The stock reacted -10% on the day, then +18% the next. Watch the dilution: $1.15B all-stock Elisity deal plus a $2.0B equity raise (Oct 16), for $3.7B pro-forma cash. With no dated catalyst left, the report goes post-stage. Core Base bias +23.7pp vs realized 14d P75 +6.6%, so Base is a multi-week horizon, not a 14-day call.
risks: Dilution: the $2B raise (20.5M shares + 29.5M pre-funded warrants) plus 100M seven-year warrants at $69.46 and Elisity's all-stock consideration expand the share count materially; growth must outrun it.
Sell-the-news history: IONQ fell ~4% on its Aug 2026 beat-and-raise; a beat alone may not be enough.
Still deeply loss-making (TTM net loss ~$1.36B incl. non-cash items) — valuation rests on long-dated quantum adoption.
Integration risk from serial M&A (Elisity on top of prior networking/security acquisitions).
High beta to yields and to quantum-peer sentiment (RGTI, QBTS moved in sympathy with the raise).

macroRisk.rateOutlook: The Fed held at 3.75–4.00% on Oct 28. After the hot Oct CPI on Nov 10, CME FedWatch prices a +25bp hike at the Dec 9 FOMC at ~89–100%, with ~10% odds of 50bp. The 10-year is ~4.98%.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Oct CPI: headline +0.4% m/m, core +0.3% m/m vs 0.2% expected. Sep core PCE 3.1% y/y. Oct PCE (Nov 25) and Nov CPI (Dec 10) are next.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: Now well-capitalized after the $2B raise, so financing risk is low. But quantum is among the highest-beta, longest-duration growth trades, and it sold off with yields in October.
macroRisk.summary: MEDIUM — a 25bp December hike is priced after the hot CPI. The tails are a 50bp move or a hot Nov 25 PCE, both of which hit small caps first, so the dip entry is preferred.
